actuators.evidence: 1.6 Nm is an SDK simulation motor cap in SundayA1_Mujoco_V1.2, not a verified continuous rating. 4.9 Nm exists in a different leg-only MPC asset and is NOT applied blindly.
actuators.missing: Exact servo suffix/gear variant, measured torque-speed curve, continuous-duty behavior and modified-finger transmission remain unmeasured.

caveats: Approximate3kg minus160g battery exactly once gives2.84kg.
Root700g is approximate metadata; COM/inertia assume uniform CAD geometry.
Remaining link masses remain estimates, not steel CAD masses or measured per-link masses.
Actuator caps and supply assumption retained pending real calibration; old results do not validate the revised dynamics.
